commands.description: Live view of your branches and worktrees above the prompt: what lands cleanly, what conflicts, who is still working

tools.name: radar
tools.description: Worktree Radar: a live, read-only view of every local branch and worktree of the repository, drawn above the prompt, sorted into lanes on their way into the base branch. Lanes: READY (clean worktree, no busy session, merges cleanly; ranked, land #1 first), NEEDS_REBASE (conflicts with the base; isRebaseDue when nothing ahead of it in waitsFor still conflicts with it), STACKED (holds another open branch; land that first), IN_PROGRESS (uncommitted changes, a rebase under way, or a busy Claude session or a running subagent there; worktree.sessions lists both, kind session or agent), HOLD, CLEANUP (nothing beyond the base and no session). It never merges, rebases, tags, pushes or moves a ref. Actions: open (starts the radar for the session folder and returns the snapshot; `wake` lists events that wake this session with a one-line report, which asks for nothing: ready, conflict, rebase-due, stacked, cleanup, base-moved, session-idle), snapshot (reads now and returns the facts as JSON), close, hold/unhold (park a branch, with a reason), comment (a short comment shown on the branch row until its tip moves; with `keep`, until it lands or is gone; empty text clears), status (one line under the queue; empty clears).

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
